title: Sunday · twenty flyers
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Twenty. The girl, seven, pinning the newest at the height she can reach — lower than the row — and the middle tier her brother, four, with the tin. The wall's two rows now: one at Gully's height and one at hers.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the shingle wall with twenty flyers: a long row high and a short row low beneath it.
